title: Last Stone Weight II

contractDetails.constraints: 1–30 stones, each with integer weight in [1,100].
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Repeatedly pick any two stones. Equal weights both disappear. Otherwise replace the pair with one stone whose weight is the difference. Return the smallest possible remaining weight, or zero if no stone remains.
constraints: 1–30 stones, each with integer weight in [1,100].
hints: Conceptual: Each subtraction corresponds to giving some original weights opposite signs.
Directional: Look for two groups with nearly equal sums.
Implementation: Find the greatest attainable subset sum no larger than half the total. The leftover is total minus twice that sum.
complexityAnalysis: O(nS) time and O(S) auxiliary space, where S is half the total weight rounded down.
